q1_issues.issue: The framing/domain PP is encoded by sealing the whole claim as the first argument of the preposition-named oblique `In`, but sealing is licensed only for propositional attitudes, embedded questions, directives, counterfactuals and `AccordingTo` — an oblique is a binary relation on a symbol, not a proposition wrapper.
A locative/domain PP restricting a kind-level claim is doctrinally routed to the `ConditionalProperty` condition slot ("rents are steep in the capital"), which this parse does not use.

`(For substitute sea_water)` hangs the complement on the bare class symbol `substitute`, so that conjunct claims something about substitutes at large rather than about salt; the kind-level complement route fuses predicate + complement into one property (the `sensitive_to_light` pattern) and puts the argument atom on the fused symbol.

The hyphenated compound `sea_water` gets no genus atom `(Inheritance sea_water water)`, which compound decomposition requires unconditionally ("always emit the genus", solid/hyphenated spellings included).

Because all content sits inside the strength-0 `In` wrapper, nothing is asserted at top level about salt, so the denied categorical is not queryable in the `(Inheritance salt <predicate>) (STV 0.0 ...)` form the copular-negation rule prescribes.

q2_gaps: copular clause whose PREDICATE NOMINAL takes a PP complement ("X is a substitute for Y"): the argument-PP section licenses `(For <noun-symbol> <argument>)` only for a referring noun that has its own witness symbol, and the fuse-into-one-property route only for an ADJECTIVE with a bare-kind complement — a predicate nominal has no symbol of its own to carry the argument
negating a kind-level claim that also carries a domain/locative restriction — no polarity treatment is stated for the `ConditionalProperty` condition-slot route
notes: `In` and `For` are both licensed heads, so nothing is listed under q4; the defect is the unlicensed sealing USE of the oblique plus the complement landing on a bare class symbol. The strength 0.0 / confidence 0.9 choice itself is right for a negated empirical kind-level claim.
